messages.subject: Dr R Whitmore — letter of claim and schedule of loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

We act for Dr Rebecca Whitmore. Please find our letter of claim and schedule of loss. ACAS early conciliation has concluded (certificate R123456/24/71). Our client's claims are automatic unfair dismissal (s.103A ERA), detriment for protected disclosures (s.47B), and unfair dismissal in the alternative. Her total loss is quantified at £206,460.

We would welcome an early without-prejudice discussion.

Eleanor Bartlett
Partner, Ashworth Quinn LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Thank you. We are taking our client's instructions and will revert with a substantive response shortly. Our client denies the claims but is open to a without-prejudice discussion. We note the schedule assumes an extended period of future loss; we reserve our position on mitigation.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP
